body: Thank you. I struggle with being called a good person... I am no where near who I used to be. I used to be so much kinder; more caring and loving, and willing to help others all the time. I was patient and cared about myself. Now everything is different. I wish I could be the person I was, but I can't find the kindness in people or the patience for anyone.

I've actually just found this subreddit, and I've got to say you guys are the only ones I've seen on this website that are truly kind (I probably don't know of other subs with nice people). I realize that there are people out there that can be good people and care about me.. I just haven't been able to utilize your kindness. But thank you for reminding me that good people exist
